rows.what_the_ink_shows: The definition has a clear numerator z_1 and a clear inserted z_2 over the crossed denominator; the deleted denominator itself remains obscured. The downward map explicitly has z_2/z_1, with a curved 2 and upright 1. The prose explicitly has e_2/e_1 = tau in D. All three readings agree with the original diplomatic transcription. See crops/144_scan042_L1433_definition.jpg, crops/144_scan042_L1433_arrow.jpg, and crops/144_scan042_L1433_prose.jpg.
rows.note: The inconsistent live ratios are written in the manuscript: z_1/z_2 in the definition versus z_2/z_1 on the arrow and e_2/e_1 in the prose. Standardizing the definition to z_2/z_1 would be a mathematical/editorial correction of the author, not an optical correction. Retain the existing deleted uncertainty under the inserted denominator; the underlying crossed strokes do not allow its safe resolution. The cited LM_140-3 page was not inspected.
